$comment: THE RELEASE-NOTE TRAILER (agent/plans/PLAN-release-notes.md D1, D2). Read by .ci/rediacc_ci/release/release_notes.py, the one module the commit-msg hook, the land check, the CI range gate, the Release body and the changelog data all import.

repos: the repositories whose feat, fix and perf commits must carry `Release-Note:`, keyed by the path the console tree knows them by (`console` for the root). A submodule absent from this map is neither required nor collected.

internal: per repo, the globs whose paths no customer sees. A commit whose every path matches one is exempt; one customer path makes a feat, fix or perf commit owe the trailer. Globs use only ** and *, as .ci/policy/record-paths.json does: ** spans any number of directories, zero included, and * stays inside one segment.
gitlinks: per repo, the submodule paths that repo records as gitlinks. A commit touching only those is a pointer bump and exempt; the submodule commit it points at carries the note.
internal_patterns and codenames: what a customer note must not name (D1). A pattern is a Python regex searched in the note; a codename is a word matched case-insensitively on word boundaries.

since: the first version whose Release body and changelog entry are built from these trailers (D11). Null until the first version cut after the CI range gate (RN4) lands; every older version shows no recorded notes.
